description: A Java class representing a MongoDB document for storing receipt or invoice metadata and versions, including fields like id, userId, title, vendor, category, amount, currency, transaction date, status, metadata, versions, and timestamps.

classes.name: ReceiptDocument
classes.description: MongoDB document storing receipt/invoice metadata and versions, annotated to define collection and compound indexes.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the id of the receipt document.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the id of the receipt document.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with the receipt.

methods.name: setUserId
methods.description: Sets the user ID associated with the receipt.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the receipt.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the receipt.

methods.name: getVendor
methods.description: Returns the vendor/vendor name.

methods.name: setVendor
methods.description: Sets the vendor/vendor name.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the receipt.

methods.name: setCategory
methods.description: Sets the category of the receipt.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the amount on the receipt.

methods.name: setAmount
methods.description: Sets the amount on the receipt.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency of the amount.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets the currency of the amount.

methods.name: getTransactionDate
methods.description: Returns the transaction date.

methods.name: setTransactionDate
methods.description: Sets the transaction date.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the receipt.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the current status of the receipt.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns additional metadata as a map.

methods.name: setMetadata
methods.description: Sets additional metadata as a map.

methods.name: getVersions
methods.description: Returns the list of document versions.

methods.name: setVersions
methods.description: Sets the list of document versions.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp.

methods.name: getUpdatedAt
methods.description: Returns the last updated timestamp.

methods.name: setUpdatedAt
methods.description: Sets the last updated timestamp.
